changes.description: Match Filter's "Match Type" dropdown no longer shows attribute names instead of match types (exact, substring, regex)
Playlist descriptions containing newlines or control characters no longer cause Spotify API 400 errors
Preview no longer shows source_count column for track-output programs that use it on an upstream artist/album stream
New source_count attribute on artist and album entities — shows how many times each entity appeared in the source stream, usable in Range Filter and Sorter for frequency-based thresholding
Artist Filter, Artist De-Dup, and Remove Duplicates now accept all entity types (tracks, artists, albums), not just tracks
Dedup key is now entity-aware — artists deduplicate by name, albums by title + artist
Shared program and program preview pages now correctly show artist/album entity colors (purple/teal headers, dashed edges) instead of defaulting to gray/green
AUTO_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION now shows adapter steps (to artists, to albums, to tracks), red/orange port exclusions, and reads as a left-to-right pipeline instead of jumbled component names
Admin overview page loads in under a second instead of ~10 seconds — scales to any database size
New playlist description variables: ${PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION} (your program's description) and ${AUTO_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION} (auto-generated summary from the dataflow topology)
Editor now auto-saves your work to the browser — navigate to FAQ, Tutorial, or any other page and come back without losing your program
Orange dot on the Editor tab shows when you have unsaved changes
Genre Filter: new 'primary genre only' option to match only the artist's first genre, avoiding false positives from deep genre tags
Artist Filter: the red (exclusion) port now accepts artist entity streams in addition to track streams
Programs page loads ~40x faster for users with large run histories
To Albums adapter now returns singles, compilations, and appears_on albums — was previously hardcoded to full albums only
Album preview now shows the artist name (was blank due to the field being stripped from cached data)
Date Filter now works on albums as well as tracks
Album preview shows album type column (album, single, compilation)
Artists and albums are now first-class entity types that flow through the graph — not just tracks
New artist sources: My Top Artists, My Artist Library, Artist (by name), Artist URIs, Country Top Artists, Genre Artists
New album sources: My Album Library, Album Entity (by name), Album URIs, Label Albums
New adapters: To Tracks, To Artists, To Albums — convert between entity types with configurable selection modes
Similar Artists adapter — find related artists via Spotify radio
Filters, sorters, and selectors adapt to entity types — Range Filter, Match Filter, and Sort show attributes appropriate for the connected input type
Color-coded graph edges: violet dashed for artists, teal dashed for albums, solid green for tracks
Component palette splits sources, filters, orders, and selectors into Generic vs Track-specific subgroups
Source and adapter node headers colored by output entity type
Results panel adapts to entity type — artist and album previews show appropriate columns with both Spotify and MusicBrainz genres
Preview mode allows non-track output for debugging (Run still requires tracks)
Connection validation checks the full downstream chain — prevents building invalid type pipelines
Artist name search improved with accent-aware fuzzy matching to avoid wrong-artist results
Country name resolution supports common aliases: UK, USA, Korea, Deutschland, Holland, and more
Tutorial and FAQ updated with entity type documentation, attribute tables, and example programs
Separate Artists now truly maximizes spacing — every artist's tracks are scheduled at evenly-spaced positions, fixing back-to-back repeats that could slip through
Service restart detection now catches dpkg upgrades (e.g. libc6) and apt-daily-upgrade runs that the unattended-upgrades log misses
Scheduled programs detect Spotify's 6-month auth expiry — jobs pause immediately and a warning is written to the playlist description
Service restart events now include context (e.g. unattended-upgrade package list)
Interrupted runs in run history now say whether the scheduler was restarted (deploy) or killed unexpectedly (e.g. memory limit)
Very large fetches are now capped at 10,000 tracks (playlists and Liked Songs); runs that hit the cap show a warning in run history
Further reduced memory usage when fetching large playlists and libraries
Artist Radio, Artist Top Tracks, Similar Tracks, and Tracks By Description now gracefully handle Spotify API errors instead of crashing the entire program
Fixed excessive memory usage when fetching large playlists or saved-tracks libraries (10K+ tracks)
Similar Tracks source attribute now shows provenance chain (e.g. 'similar to Radiohead via Your Top Tracks')
Similar Tracks now sets the source attribute on output tracks (e.g. 'similar to Radiohead')
Added 'random' track attribute — use in MOS with low-weight Maximize to get different playlist orderings each run
Added Playable Filter component — removes tracks unavailable in your market, with optional relinking to replace them with playable alternatives
Added Similar Tracks component — expands each input track into related tracks by similar artists
CSV export now preserves non-English characters (added UTF-8 BOM)
Increased maximum scheduled update run limit from 100 to 365
Run history now shows actual tracks saved instead of pre-dedup count when 'No Dups' is enabled
Playlist trim no longer resets 'Date added' timestamps for tracks past position 100
Dedup now matches by song title + artist instead of track ID, catching duplicate songs across singles, albums, and reissues
New programs auto-name uniquely (Untitled, Untitled 2, ...) so previewing never conflicts
Batch select and delete programs from the Programs page, with schedule warnings
Schedule periodic runs directly from the editor's Program Settings dialog
Scheduler now runs up to 4 jobs concurrently, reducing late starts when many programs are due at once
Fixed MOS distribution objective collapsing same-URI tracks from different sources into one entry, making source-based distribution impossible
Source alias — set a custom label on any source (in Advanced) for use in distribution objectives and track display
Duplicate sources are automatically disambiguated with #1, #2 suffixes so distribution objectives can distinguish them
Tag programs for organization — add tags like "daily", "party", or "in progress" from program settings or the quick-tag button on the programs page
Filter programs by tags — clickable tag chips above the programs table to filter by one or more tags
Tag autocomplete suggests existing tags while typing; comma-separated input for adding multiple tags at once
Run history page — view full run history for any program with status, tracks, API calls, cache hits, duration, and manual vs. scheduled trigger
History button added to program actions for quick access to run history
Stopped schedules now show a clear error message when a program fails 3 consecutive runs
Fixed distribution objective failing to parse multi-word values like 'Quieter gothic metal(20%)'
Added release_decade attribute for filtering, sorting, and displaying tracks by decade (e.g. 1970, 1980)
Attribute dropdowns are now sorted alphabetically
Configurable track display — add, remove, and drag-to-reorder columns directly on the results table, saved per program
SmarterPlaylists 3.0 — out of beta!
Components dragged from palette onto empty canvas now appear at the drop location instead of the center
Fixed MusicBrainz ETL cron job failing because uv was not in cron's minimal PATH
New Distribution objective for MOS — target percentage distributions of attribute values (e.g. 30% female, 20% rock)
Fixed MOS error messages showing [object Object] instead of readable component names
MOS reference docs updated with Distribution and Continuity objectives
Fixed camelot_num wrap-around in Continuity and Variety objectives — distance from 24 to 1 was treated as 23 instead of 1
Admin dashboard now shows Daily Users and New Users charts alongside Daily Runs
Added Continuity objective for Multi-Objective Sequencer — scores candidates by distance from the last track's attribute value, enabling smooth transitions or deliberate contrast
Fixed Camelot attributes (camelot, camelot_num) not being computed when used in filters or sorters — audio features were not fetched as a prerequisite
Discover page can be sorted by most shared, trending, newest, oldest, most complex, or least complex
Discover page now shows component count and share date columns
Multi-Objective Sequencer nodes now display a readable description of all objectives directly on the canvas, with attribute names in bold and weight/slot annotations
Match Max Run MOS objective limits consecutive runs of same-value tracks (e.g. max 3 by same artist, then 5 others before repeating)
Range Max Run MOS objective limits consecutive runs of tracks in a numeric range, with configurable separation gap
Playlist auto-reset (weekly/monthly) no longer resets on every run during the reset day — only the first run triggers the reset
Saving or running a program with an empty name now shows a clear error instead of a cryptic validation message
MOS slot syntax now supports section notation (e.g. 1/4 for 'first quarter') that scales proportionally with the playlist limit
Order By objective spread is now a three-way mode: off, full, or segment — segment spread makes each slot segment span the full value range independently
MOS editor lays out extra objective params on a single row to reduce vertical space
Discover page now paginates (20 per page) instead of showing a fixed top-50 list
Scheduled runs with Multi-Objective Sequencer failed because objective types were not registered in the scheduler process
Export CSV button on track results to download playlist tracks as a CSV file
Track URIs component accepts space/newline-separated input and Spotify URLs, with a larger text area for bulk pasting
Playlist Analytics panel — view summary stats, per-track attribute charts, genre pie chart, and categorical distributions for generated playlists
Results panel remembers height and selected tab between runs
Snap-to-half button to quickly expand the results panel
MOS node titles show a compact objective summary
New Multi-Objective Sequencer (MOS) component — sequence tracks using weighted objectives like maximize, minimize, order-by, variety, min-separation, range, target, match, and contains
Dedicated MOS editor with per-objective configuration, validation, and slot-based position targeting
MOS reference guide accessible from the FAQ page
Fixed run queue permanently rejecting all programs after a server restart
Added track attributes reference table to FAQ with descriptions of all 35 filterable/sortable attributes
Added record label attribute — filter and sort tracks by label via MatchFilter and Sorter
Allow deeper zoom out in the flow editor so large programs fit on screen
Smart Mix now has a limit parameter (default 50) — feed it a large pool and it picks the best N tracks for smooth transitions
Added Smart Mix order component — reorders tracks for smooth DJ-style transitions using genre, energy, Camelot harmonic compatibility, and tempo
Added Camelot wheel code as a track attribute (camelot and camelot_num) — derived from key and mode, available for sorting and filtering
Save to Playlist now correctly empties the playlist when zero tracks are piped in (replace mode) instead of leaving it untouched
Version number in nav bar is now clickable — links to the changelog
Save to Playlist now has a 'no duplicates' option — in append mode, skips tracks already in the playlist; in replace mode, deduplicates incoming tracks
Alternator now respects the fail_fast parameter — stops when any input is exhausted instead of always continuing through all streams
Switched Spotify metadata cache from SQLite to Redis — eliminates database locking under concurrent load
New Country Top Tracks source — generates popular tracks from artists of a given country using MusicBrainz + Spotify data, with cache-first popularity ranking
Simplified gender filter options: removed ensemble variants, added 'other' for non-binary artists
Add artist gender, country, area, type, and active years from MusicBrainz data
New Gender Filter component — filter by vocalist gender (male, female, mixed, instrumental, etc.)
New Country Filter component — filter by artist country (ISO codes like US, GB, JP)
Artist start/end year and is_active available as filter and sort attributes
Fix MatchFilter not triggering decoration for non-base attributes
Fix MusicBrainz area hierarchy resolution (cities now resolve to correct country)
Fix startup crash when apt auto-upgrades trigger systemd re-exec — SQLite busy_timeout now set before journal_mode pragma so workers wait for locks instead of failing
Tap a connection to show a delete button — enables editing flows on mobile without a keyboard
Fix database locked errors caused by TRUNCATE checkpoints taking exclusive locks — switch to non-blocking PASSIVE checkpoints
Fix cache WAL file growing unbounded (40GB+) by checkpointing every 15min with TRUNCATE, adding periodic expired-entry cleanup, and setting journal_size_limit
New Intersection component — outputs only tracks that appear in all input streams
MySavedAlbums and ArtistDiscography only returning first page of results (50 items max)
New Pager component — progressively pages through a source's tracks across scheduled runs, wrapping around at the end
IsDayOfWeek regtest using local timezone instead of UTC, causing spurious failures
Cache control on all source components via cache_mode param (auto/no-cache/short-term/long-term)
Last.fm API responses now cached with per-method default TTLs (1h-7d), reducing API calls on repeated runs
Advanced params: component editor has a collapsible Advanced section for power-user settings
Per-component persistent state: components can now save/load state across runs via get_state()/set_state()
Auto-redirect to login when Spotify session expires instead of showing cryptic JavaScript error
Admin jobs page: 'overdue' filter to see queued jobs, clickable Queue Depth card, overdue duration on Next Run column
Infrastructure errors in scheduler no longer count toward 3-strike job stop limit
Added 'running' and 'interrupted' to admin runs status filter
Fixed all scheduled jobs crashing due to sqlite3.Row not supporting .get() for lastfm_username
Scheduler errors during context setup now properly recorded instead of leaving zombie 'running' entries
Fixed PlaylistSave renaming existing playlists to 'My Smarter Playlist' when playlist URI is provided with blank name
7 new Last.fm source components — User's Recent Tracks, User's Top Tracks, User's Loved Tracks, Similar Tracks, Tag Top Tracks, Global Top Tracks, and Geo Top Tracks
Last.fm username setting in user profile for default Last.fm identity
Source palette split into Spotify Sources and Last.fm Sources sections
Last.fm logo icon on component nodes and palette
Search box on My Programs page to quickly find programs by name
Fixed validation errors on My Top Tracks, artist top tracks, and recently played when Spotify returns tracks with null album data
Playlist description field on Save to Playlist and Save to New Playlist — supports template variables like ${DATE}, ${NUM_TRACKS}, ${DURATION}, and more
All playlists now get a default description ('Created by SmarterPlaylists') even without an explicit Save component
Reduced 'database is locked' errors by increasing SQLite busy timeout and using non-blocking WAL checkpoints
Prevent unbounded cache WAL growth with periodic checkpoints (avoids disk-full outage)
Admin interface is now mobile-responsive — collapsible sidebar, compact tables with hidden low-priority columns, and tighter spacing on small screens
Date-sensitive components now use your local timezone instead of server time — weekday checks, date ranges, playlist resets, and date suffixes all match your actual local date and time
Date Range shows a single date instead of a repeated range when start and end dates match
Added Date Range conditional component — route tracks based on whether today falls within a configurable date range, with year-boundary wrap support
Fixed admin cache key type breakdown showing 'v3' instead of actual entity types after cache versioning
Playlist caching with user-controllable cache mode (auto/no-cache/short-term/long-term) on playlist source components
Tiered cache TTLs — immutable data (tracks, albums, artists) cached for 7 days instead of 1 hour, reducing API calls by ~50%
Slimmed cached objects strip to only used fields, reducing cache storage ~96% (5 GB → ~200 MB)
Added 'New Users Today' card to admin overview dashboard
Fixed run queue failing with multiple uvicorn workers by switching from in-memory to SQLite-backed storage
Interactive run queue — runs are queued instead of rejected when all execution slots are busy, with real-time status feedback
Admin runs page shows queue wait time and delayed run percentage
Admin users page now has search by name or ID
Admin user detail tables are sortable by clicking column headers, and run rows navigate to the program
Relaxed 'late' threshold for scheduled runs from 1 minute to 14 minutes
Admin databases page loads much faster — parallelized queries across databases, skipped slow per-table size scan on large DBs, batched row counts
Admin runs page shows scheduled vs interactive percentage, late run percentage, and average duration cards
Added hourly runs stacked bar chart to admin runs page showing interactive, scheduled on-time, and scheduled late runs
Replaced reschedule_failed script with rerun_failed — re-runs programs immediately without altering job schedules
Admin can run a program on behalf of its owner from the program detail page (useful for re-running after deploy interruptions)
Admin program detail page now shows links to Spotify playlists updated by the program
Fixed attribute range limits for duration, artist followers, tempo, loudness, track/disc number to allow real-world extremes
Improved error messages when Spotify API calls fail during program execution
Eliminated unnecessary Spotify album API calls by extracting release_date from track metadata
Fan-out support: a component's output can now connect to multiple downstream components, enabling split/parallel processing pipelines
Admin backups panel now shows daily/weekly rotation tiers with individual file sizes
Added Max Tracks Per Artist filter — limits how many tracks by any single artist can pass through
Validate component parameters on Done click — inline field errors prevent saving invalid settings
Pre-run and pre-schedule validation catches misconfigured programs before Spotify API calls
Added range constraints to all numeric fields (limits, tempos, separations, durations) to reject nonsensical values
IsDayOfWeek dropdown now renders correctly (was showing as text input due to unresolved JSON Schema $ref)
Cache DB lock no longer causes program execution failures — writes are silently skipped
Track 'server busy' rejections in run history with rejection rate stats on admin runs page
Admin jobs page: sort by next run, fix queue depth metric, show day/week stats as cards
Fixed SavedAlbumPaging validation crash by bypassing tekore's strict Pydantic parsing for saved albums and tracks
Fixed app server crash on startup when cache database is locked by scheduler
Interrupted scheduled runs are now tracked and visible in run history instead of silently lost
Scheduled jobs now run in chronological order when multiple are due at once
Fixed crash when Spotify returns null items in saved albums, saved tracks, or other paging responses
Fixed overnight scheduled job failures caused by cache database VACUUM holding exclusive lock
Admin DB page shows per-table sizes (data + indexes) with column headers
Vacuum button on admin DB page to reclaim free pages and shrink database files
Improved genre accuracy with Spotify artist ID matching from MusicBrainz, plus alias and text normalization fallbacks
MusicBrainz data moved to separate database file for simpler backups of user data
Genre Filter now uses artist name matching instead of ISRC lookup, reducing MusicBrainz database from 925MB to ~84MB
Admin dashboard DB tab showing size, row counts, cache breakdown, and MusicBrainz ETL status for all databases
Artist objects from followed artists and related artists are now cached individually, preserving Spotify genre data for future lookups
New Genre Filter component — filter tracks by MusicBrainz genre using ISRC matching with artist name fallback (81% coverage on test data)
Spotify API responses now cache individual tracks from list endpoints (playlists, saved tracks, top tracks, artist top tracks), avoiding redundant API calls on subsequent runs

Spotify API cache now stores batch results (albums, artists, tracks, audio features) as individual entities instead of per-combination, preventing unbounded cache growth that caused a 46GB database and server outage
New Match Filter component — filter tracks by matching title, artist, or album against a value using exact, substring, or regex matching with optional inversion
Title templates now support $ternary(param, trueVal, falseVal) syntax for conditional text in node titles
Fixed System Calls and Workers columns in Spotify Failures table showing cumulative totals instead of the 1-minute window around each failure
Rate limit indicators on admin API chart are now clearly visible even when dwarfed by normal call volume
Chart tooltip no longer gets stuck in the left third — follows cursor across the full chart width
Program run history page — click the run count on any program to see full details: status, tracks, API calls, cache hits, duration, and timing for every run, plus scheduled job status
Admin dashboard now shows active run concurrency gauge on System page and heaviest users table on Overview page for faster incident diagnosis

Spotify failures table on admin API page now shows both 429 rate limits and 5xx server errors with system call volume context
Fixed rate limit events not appearing in admin API page — retries, errors, and 429s are now recorded in the correct minute bucket when they happen instead of being lost at flush time
Rate limit events table now shows total system API calls (±1min) and active worker count, to help identify the rate limit threshold
Round response time values in API chart tooltip to whole milliseconds
Track results table columns are now sortable — click headers to sort ascending, again for descending, third click to reset
New API tab in admin dashboard shows Spotify API call rate over time, rate limit (429) events, cache hit rate, and response times
Date Filter now accepts relative dates (e.g. '6 months', '30 days') and partial dates ('2020', '2020-06')
Unified date/duration parsing across Date Filter, Relative Dated Playlist, and Recently Played components
Input validation with clear error messages for invalid date and duration values
Node titles wrap to two lines instead of truncating, with full text on hover tooltip
Admin Activity table now shows scheduled run % and uses compact two-table side-by-side layout
Run durations display as seconds (e.g. 29.6s) instead of raw milliseconds
Fixed 'database is locked' errors during concurrent access by adding SQLite busy_timeout
Added security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) to all responses
MOTD messages are now sanitized to prevent XSS
Program names limited to 255 chars, descriptions to 5000 chars, request bodies to 2MB
Rate limiting on program create/update/delete, sharing, and migration endpoints
Share codes increased from 8 to 16 characters for better brute-force resistance
Admin performance metrics now show today/week/overall breakdowns in a table layout
Added Recently Played source component — pulls your recent Spotify listening history with optional time window filters (e.g. '2h', '7d')
Added schedule frequency options: every 2 hours, 4 hours, 8 hours, and every 2 weeks
Fixed playlist trim removing all copies of duplicate tracks instead of just the oldest — now correctly preserves newer copies
Fixed playlist trim reading the entire playlist just to check the track count — now uses a single cheap API call to skip trimming when under the cap
Added dark mode with three settings: System (follows OS), Light, and Dark — toggle via the icon in the header
Default canvas zoom is slightly reduced for better overview of large programs
Raised max input port limit from 10 to 100 to support programs with many connected sources
Error messages in admin runs table now wrap instead of being truncated
Fixed blank optional numeric params (num_tracks, num_albums, num_artists) causing validation errors instead of being treated as 'all'
Validation error messages now show component display name and field-level details instead of raw internal errors
Disable caching for all playlist tracks — personalized editorial playlists (37i9d*) were returning stale results

Added auto-reset schedule (weekly/monthly) to Save to Playlist for periodic playlist clearing
Component editor help text now renders paragraphs with spacing for readability
Component editor modal widened for better readability
Track preview close button moved above the player so it no longer overlaps the Spotify logo
Closing the track preview now pauses playback if the track is playing

Component editor modal is now draggable — grab the header to move it and see the canvas behind it

My Saved Albums now supports limiting tracks per album

Promote from Alpha to Beta — your programs and playlists are now preserved across updates

Tutorial table of contents links now scroll to the section instead of navigating away
Fixed auto-layout making program disappear by fitting the viewport after layout and undo
Fixed browser back button not working when leaving a shared program page

Added credit caption to tutorial screenshot

Added FAQ entries for playlist saving confusion, where to ask questions, and project attribution

Snap-to-grid toggle for precise node alignment
Multi-select via drag-to-select rectangles and Cmd+Click
Cycle prevention rejects connections that would create loops in the graph
Updated FAQ with editor shortcuts and new feature documentation

Show component description in editor and display help text inline without toggle

Comment nodes restyle as customizable annotations with style, color, and size options
Fix deleting legacy-imported programs (foreign key constraint error)

Discover tab showing most-imported shared programs
Program Settings dialog for editing descriptions

Allow scheduling with all available intervals (3 days, monthly, quarterly, etc.)
Fixed excessive vertical spacing in migrated program layouts

Changelog page viewable at #changelog, accessible without login
